---
name: manual-test-design
description: Produce reviewable manual cases and exploratory charters from evidence-backed requirements and risks.
---
# Manual test design

For each case provide ID, objective, requirement/risk, preconditions, synthetic data, steps, expected result, cleanup, and uncertainty. Include invalid, boundary, transition, and error scenarios based on risk. Add exploratory charters where scripted expected results would invent policy. Avoid redundant manual repetition of automated coverage without a rationale. Ask for SME input when outcomes are ambiguous.
